description: The Komanawa Groundwater Detection Power Calculator is a Python package for estimating whether monitoring can detect a future change in water quality. It combines a proposed concentration scenario with measurement noise and, where relevant, groundwater lag, and evaluates detection power for supported statistical tests. A modeller can use the results to assess whether a monitoring design could detect expected changes affecting groundwater-fed drinking-water supplies. Its geographic coverage is site-dependent; the monitoring period and sampling design are user inputs. Source code and API documentation are publicly available through GitHub and PyPI, and the software is free under LGPL-3.0. A limitation is that its detection probabilities depend on the assumed signal, unexplained variability and lag model. It provides a Python interface without a command-line interface. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review checked documentation and licence metadata without running a power analysis or collecting water-quality observations.
